## PositionUtils.getWithdrawable() function

Returns the maximum credit units currently withdrawable by a position.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getWithdrawable(params: {
        readonly position: Pick<IPosition, "credit">;
        readonly market: Pick<IMarket, "withdrawable">;
    }): bigint;
```

**Returns:**

bigint

The lower of the position credit and market withdrawable liquidity.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.position`<!-- -->: Position whose credit limits the withdrawal.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Market whose available liquidity limits the withdrawal.

## Example


```ts
import { PositionUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const withdrawable = PositionUtils.getWithdrawable({
  position: { credit: 1_000n },
  market: { withdrawable: 500n },
});
console.log(withdrawable); // 500n
```
